title: Level 10: Performance, Reliability, and Observability
description: Measure, improve, and operate Android startup, rendering, memory, battery, size, stability, recovery, privacy-safe observability, and release health through reproducible laboratory and field evidence.
plannedTopics: Representative profiling of CPU, memory, rendering, Compose, battery, network, and delivery size
Cold, warm, and hot startup; App Startup; Macrobenchmark; Baseline and Startup Profiles
ANRs, crashes, OOM, retry storms, kill switches, compatible migrations, and roll-forward recovery
Structured logging, crash context, analytics, SLIs, dashboards, release gates, and the performance evidence capstone

project.title: Measured Performance and Release Health Investigation
project.summary: Diagnose and improve a slow application, add verified profiles and regression guards, then operate it through privacy-safe SLIs, cohort gates, and recovery.

theme.mapMood: Measured paths from user action to frames, resources, failures, and operational signals.
